taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: SAML metadata update provenance and effective signing-key trust
controls.source_trace: Determine who can replace an entity descriptor or endpoint and how new signing keys become trusted. Separate metadata authentication from assertion validation.
controls.implementation_branch: Metadata can be authenticated by an approved signed distribution or another deliberate pinned trust channel; unsigned is not universally unsafe. Bind entityID and rollover keys to that channel. Distinguish an administrator-approved new IdP from an attacker-controlled metadata source replacing an existing trusted entity.
controls.operational_method: For aggregated metadata, retain the exact signed descriptor scope and selected entityID entry, not merely a successful signature somewhere in the document. Verify the entity entry and rollover keys consumed by the SP derive from the authenticated scope/distribution policy. A locally altered unsigned sibling entry is a useful negative control; a trusted administrator intentionally approving a different IdP is privileged setup.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned IdP/SP fixture with a legitimate rollover and an unauthorized metadata source/entity substitution.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An old certificate remaining during an approved rollover window is not automatically a trust bypass; record the actual acceptance policy.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Authenticate metadata updates and bind them to the intended entity, preserving controlled rollover and failure recovery.
